A bare URL has nowhere to break, so this line ran past the margin and off the
sheet: see https://example.com/reports/2026/annual/appendix_b/data_tables/regional_breakdown_by_quarter_and_business_unit.html
for the tables. The rest of the line was cut, and the log called it a warning.
